title: IntegrationInterface (catalogue instance schema)
description: Catalogue-instance projection of the metamodel IntegrationInterface entity. The normative field set is defined by the metamodel schema; this file mirrors it and adds only the catalogue-instance layer (classification axes promoted to first-class fields by CR-IS-CAT-04B, service or component bindings, governance, provenance). Do not widen a normative enum here to accept a value the metamodel does not define: fix the record instead. A catalogue that diverges from the metamodel is a second source of truth.

id.description: OpenDEAM-local identifier. The metamodel pattern is the general ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-z0-9-]+$; this catalogue narrows it to the IF entity namespace so a record cannot be filed under another entity's identifier form.

lifecycle_status.description: CR-3R: lifecycle state from the metamodel lifecycle vocabulary.

interface_kind.description: Classification axis 1 (CR-IS-CAT-04B): what kind of boundary the interface is. Derived deterministically from the bound service's interaction pattern at population time. Promoted from the interface-kind tag to a first-class field; the tag remains as a mirror; the taxonomy gate asserts the two agree.

consumer_class.description: Classification axis 2 (CR-IS-CAT-04B): who the boundary serves. Inherited from the bound service or component. Promoted from the consumer-class tag; the taxonomy gate asserts tag and field agree.

interaction_pattern.description: Classification axis 3 (CR-IS-CAT-04B): how the exchange is shaped. Inherited from the bound service or component. Promoted from the interaction-pattern tag; the taxonomy gate asserts tag and field agree.

external_references.description: Identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEAM id (E004). Vendor systems appear here as corroboration evidence only (G-12); at least 3 distinct vendor systems are cited per record.

service_binding.description: Catalogue-instance layer. The ISS service contract this interface operationalises. Exactly one of service_binding and component_binding is present on a record.

service_id.description: Resolves against the vendored ISS snapshot (D4).

component_binding.description: Catalogue-instance layer. The ISC component that exposes this boundary directly, used when the exposure belongs to a component rather than to a single service contract. Exactly one of service_binding and component_binding is present on a record.

component_id.description: Resolves against the vendored ISC snapshot (D4).

governance.description: Catalogue-instance layer. Ownership and review state.
